description: This file contains utility functions for parsing URL parameters related to the 'explore' feature in Apache Superset, including handling search and path parameters, and converting them into a flattened object for API requests.

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of location objects with search and pathname properties.

methods.name: getParsedExploreURLParams
methods.description: Main function that combines and parses URL search and path parameters into a flattened object suitable for API requests.
